status_note: This database is intentionally EMPTY on the day the system was built.
A scoring discrepancy is only ever written here by the detector, and only when it has two
captured official states (or one official artifact plus a documented official statement) that
differ. Nothing is seeded from memory, media reports or assumptions, so there are no
placeholder rows to mistake for verified history.
To populate it with the historical census, run (from a machine with normal internet access,
python -m nhl_monitor monitor --date $(date -u +%F)     # run every few minutes on game days

official_sources_verified: Wayback CDX + archived copies of the official documents
sources_not_available_as_machine_readabl: NHL Situation Room rulings feed (not located)

season_coverage_measured.20232024: verified: GS/ES/PL/RO retrievable; reports regenerated (not original-state)
season_coverage_measured.20242025: verified: report path archived in the Wayback CDX index
season_coverage_measured.20162017: verified: GS retrievable and frozen at game time (original state preserved)
season_coverage_measured.20052006: verified: GS/ES retrievable and frozen at game time
season_coverage_measured.19992000: verified ABSENT: 19992000/GS020001.HTM returns 404; earliest season not yet bounded

known_evidence_gaps: No record has been produced yet: the build sandbox has no network route to NHL hosts.
The exact season where reports stopped being regenerated is measured but not yet bracketed tighter than 2016-17 .. 2023-24.
Archive snapshot density is low for most games, so most historical changes will only be recoverable via the frozen-era method, not via archives.
